_source: Facts drawn from the client's own 2026 Company Introduction and 2025 Teamwork Company Profile in Google Drive. Figures are their published claims and must not be inflated, rounded up or embellished.
_writingRule: Never carry a sentence across from the source documents. Take the fact, then write it fresh. This applies to the client's own material, not only to competitor research: reusing the old wording drags the old site's phrasing problems into the new one, and duplicate text between fatop.com.tw and this site splits their search ranking. Part names, model numbers and specification values are identifiers, not prose, and are used exactly as published.

positioning.line: Automation equipment for motor production — not motors.
positioning.summary: Teamwork Automation designs and builds the machinery that manufactures electric motors: winding, insulation, insertion, fusing, turning, balancing, varnish and test. Founded in Taichung in 1992 to replace manual motor assembly with machines, and shipping complete production lines rather than isolated equipment.

proof.label: Listed public companies guided through new plant and project launches
Building motor production equipment in Taichung, Taiwan
Export markets: USA, India, China, Japan and Southeast Asia
Semiconductor equipment since — the rare builder working across both motors and electronics

services.title: Standalone machinery
services.body: Individual machines from the catalogue, specified against your stator, armature or rotor.

services.title: Turnkey production lines
services.body: Separate workstations linked into a single line, with the transfer method chosen against the throughput you are planning for. The target is a line that runs a shift without an operator standing at it.

services.title: Full customisation
services.body: Where no catalogue machine fits the part, the equipment is designed around it.

services.title: Project consultation and delivery
services.body: Plant planning from zero, not just equipment supply. Line layout, workstation count and commissioning.

services.title: Remote worldwide support
services.body: Any PLC-equipped machine can carry the remote monitoring module. Engineers diagnose over the internet, so a fault in another timezone does not wait for a flight.

timeline.event: The company opens in Taichung with a single purpose: take the manual work out of motor assembly. A winding machine is the first thing it builds.
Individual machines give way to a linked line. It is the first of the plant projects that listed manufacturers would later bring us in on.
The TWM-702 armature winder becomes the machine most Taiwanese motor plants of its class are running.
Sealing and testing equipment ships to a semiconductor customer. A second industry, held to a tighter tolerance than motors ask for.
A production line built specifically for drone motors. The second one goes to a customer in the United States.
Hairpin stator work starts, prototyping with customers. Hairpin is what EV traction motors are wound with, so this is where the next decade is.
FaTop Automation opens as the route for buyers outside Taiwan to reach us directly.
